Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
In accordance with Regulation 30 and 46(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligation and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and in furtherance to the intimation about Earnings Call submitted  
on October 22, 2026 we hereby inform that the recording of the Earnings Call held on October 27, 
2026 at 4.00 p.m. IST is available on the website of the Company at www.acutaas.com. 
 
The recording can be accessed from the below link: 
https://backend.acutaas.com/resources/investor/10047956-1793102736502.mp3         
 
Kindly take the same on record.  
 
Yours faithfully, 
For, ACUTAAS CHEMICALS LIMITED 
 
 
Ekta Kumari Srivastava
